pick.headline: Archbishop Oscar Romero assassinated
pick.summary: On March 24, 1980, Archbishop Oscar Romero of San Salvador was shot dead while celebrating Mass, a day after appealing to soldiers to stop killing.
pick.significance: The killing, by a death squad linked to Roberto D'Aubuisson, marked El Salvador's descent into full civil war.
